purpose: Living catalog of every user-facing feature/action in FlowState, each with the surfaces it appears on, the behaviour it must hold, the states it must hold under, and an evidence pointer. Audited by scripts/audit-feature-matrix.cjs. This is derived from the real codebase (routes, store operations, component handlers) — add rows as features ship; never invent features that do not exist.

statusLegend.audited: an automated test asserts this feature's behaviour
statusLegend.partial: some facets covered; named gaps remain
statusLegend.unaudited: no direct evidence yet — candidate for a regression

features.action: Create a task (quick-add, form, AI, API)
features.expected: Task exists in store + durable queue with one canonical id; survives reload; no duplicate on cross-client/echo.

features.action: Edit task title
features.expected: New title persists; blank does not overwrite a real title; failed save warns and keeps the edit.

features.action: Edit task description (rich text)
features.expected: Markdown serialised faithfully; a debounced edit is flushed on modal close AND on unmount; failed save warns.

features.action: Change status / mark done / reopen
features.expected: Status persists; completion is exactly-once and idempotent; reopen reachable from a filtered view; done at zero handled.

features.action: Set priority (low/medium/high/clear)
features.expected: Priority persists incl. clearing to null; right-click failure is visible.

features.action: Set / clear due date and time
features.expected: Due date persists incl. null-clear readback; date projection is timezone-stable.

features.action: Pin / unpin a task
features.expected: Pin state persists and is visible; quick-action failure is surfaced.

features.action: Delete a task (soft, undoable)
features.expected: Optimistic removal; on queue failure the task is restored, pending write cleared, error toasted; writes a tombstone so it cannot resurrect.

features.action: Permanently delete (single + bulk, all-or-none)
features.expected: Atomic: all requested rows deleted or none; tombstones written; rolls back on server failure.

features.action: Undo / redo any task action
features.expected: Linear branch: new action after undo discards redo; undo→redo round-trips; rollback on failure.

features.action: Drag a card between status columns
features.expected: Card moves, status updates, order persists; the drag clone follows the cursor and the drop registers.
gaps: webkit drop intermittently does not register (open product defect)

features.action: Drag a card between due-date columns (Overdue→Today etc.)
features.expected: Card re-buckets by dueDate, not by stale instance; stays in the new column after drop.

features.action: Reorder cards within a column
features.expected: Order persists across reload; no card lost.
gaps: the bulk order-index persistence path is covered via bulk-update; the drag-reorder index computation lives inline in KanbanColumn.vue and needs a component/E2E mount to fully cover

features.action: Switch board grouping (status/date/priority)
features.expected: Grouping choice persists (localStorage) and re-buckets correctly.

features.action: Schedule a task onto a date/time (create instance)
features.expected: Instance created; calendar and task views converge; no stale instance pinning.

features.action: Drag or resize a calendar instance
features.expected: Time/duration updates and persists; ripple-shift respects calendar-locked tasks.
gaps: resize edge cases noted in project status (Calendar ⚠️ Partial)

features.action: Right-click complete / reopen on a calendar instance
features.expected: Converges offline, cross-client, and after reload; next-occurrence exactly once.

features.action: Remove a task from the calendar
features.expected: Removal rejection stays visible and leaves the task intact.

features.action: Show external (Google) calendar events read-only
features.expected: Provider-owned, namespaced ids; idempotent re-sync; timezone-correct; never converted to owned tasks silently.
gaps: live offline/reconnect provider round-trip needs a live Google harness

features.action: Drag a task node
features.expected: Only the dragged task's geometry changes; other nodes do not shift; position persists across reload.

features.action: Drag a task into / out of a group
features.expected: Only parentId + position change; membership persists; no drift.

features.action: Create / delete / collapse a group (day column, custom)
features.expected: Group persists; collapse hides children; delete reparents children atomically.
gaps: newly-created group does not propagate live to other clients (open product defect R7)

features.action: Resize a group / section
features.expected: Position + dimensions update; resize locks released in a finally block.

features.action: Tidy / rotate day-group layout
features.expected: Idempotent — a second run emits zero moves; no write storm; group height derives from placed tasks.

features.action: Remove a task from the canvas
features.expected: Stays removed across reload — dismissed flag persists so auto-placement does not re-add it.

features.action: Connect / disconnect task nodes (edges)
features.expected: Connection persists; undo/redo consistent.

features.action: First canvas load merges cache + remote + realtime
features.expected: Sync is read-only; fresh local groups preserved; stale zombies dropped; single-writer holds.

features.action: Add / rename / complete / move / delete subtasks
features.expected: Every write is awaited, rolled-back, and reports failure (no silent loss).

features.action: Add planning notes and draw connections
features.expected: Notes + user-drawn edges persist on the parent task; survive modal close/reopen.

features.action: Start / stop / pause / resume a focus session
features.expected: Visible timer clears locally first; stop is durable; state machine consistent.

features.action: Complete a session (award credit, history)
features.expected: Exactly-once per session id; pomodoro credit awaited + failure surfaced; break popup does not loop.

features.action: Add extra time to a running session
features.expected: Extends and re-allows completion (clears completed-id guard).

features.action: Cross-device leadership + follower polling
features.expected: One leader counts down; followers poll; leadership claim + heartbeat; auth-aware init.

features.action: Start / run / complete a Quick Sort session
features.expected: Session state persists; interrupted session recovers; snapshot isolates new tasks.

features.action: Postpone the current card
features.expected: Idempotent; double-click guarded; rapid clicks coalesce to one write; only the popup closes; opaque feedback.

features.action: Undo / redo Quick Sort swipes
features.expected: Reverses previous swipe; three-cycle consistent across all action types.

features.action: Complete a recurring task → clone next occurrence
features.expected: Advances exactly once; next occurrence anchored to stored date (clock-independent); done-for-now variants.

features.action: Edit / stop a recurrence rule
features.expected: Chain not deleted when clearing recurrence cannot persist; repeated stop while in flight ignored.

features.action: Create / rename / delete a lane
features.expected: Lane delete detaches every member task atomically — fail closed if any cannot detach (no dangling reference).

features.action: Add / remove a task from a lane
features.expected: laneId persists; cross-project membership shown; unassigned on lane delete.

features.action: Automatic backup on a timer
features.expected: Runs every 5 min; a failure is reported once (transition into failure) and recovery re-arms it — never silent.

features.action: Create a backup (manual/auto/golden)
features.expected: Captures all task fields, projects, groups, settings, tombstones; refuses on a live/tombstone contradiction; checksum.

features.action: Restore a backup (full / selective)
features.expected: Atomic; parent-before-child order; readback verified; refuses corrupt/different-account; fails closed.

features.action: Export to file / import from file
features.expected: Self-sufficient artifact; truncated/non-JSON files refused with no partial restore.
gaps: true crash-during-export + Electron-restart + cross-instance restore needs a live filesystem/Electron harness

features.action: Guest backup + guest→account transition
features.expected: Guest backup restorable in guest mode and after signing in; account-locked backups blocked across accounts.

features.action: Queue writes offline, drain on reconnect
features.expected: Replay in enqueue order (monotonic, clock-jump-immune); no duplicates; survives reload/crash.

features.action: Receive live changes from other clients
features.expected: Task changes propagate live; version/timestamp guards prevent echo stomp; scope-filtered.
gaps: newly-created GROUPS do not propagate live (open product defect R7)

features.action: Catch up missed changes via canonical change log
features.expected: Monotonic sequence paging; scope isolation; reconcile task ids + tombstones; restart baseline.

features.action: Switch workspace clears + reloads scoped data
features.expected: Outgoing workspace data wiped; incoming loaded; no leak; durable writes resume.

features.action: Filter/sort tasks (status, project, priority, smart views)
features.expected: Filtered views exclude soft-deleted; reopen reachable from filtered; counts accurate.

features.action: Move tasks to/from inbox
features.expected: isInInbox persists; bulk move to inbox is one undo entry with all ids.

features.action: Load a large task inventory completely
features.expected: Keyset pagination fetches all rows past the server row cap.

features.action: Apply an AI day plan / smart lanes via command batch
features.expected: Applied through the command substrate with a durable audit + rollback receipt; confirmation shown; rollback on failure.

features.action: AI remembers preferences / context across sessions
features.expected: Memory retrieved within freshness window (stale dropped); clock-independent fixtures.

features.action: Create/read/update/complete tasks via the local API
features.expected: Canonical receipts; safe subtask normalisation; fails closed on malformed input.

features.action: KDE widget shows + controls the timer (follower polling)
features.expected: Follower polls the local timer endpoint every 2s; countdown mirrors the app; leader/follower model holds; stale-active adoption guarded.

features.action: KDE widget extends / completes a session
features.expected: Extend re-allows completion; completion is exactly-once and does not double-fire.

features.action: A paused timer clears when the app closes (no zombie/stuck timer)
features.expected: A PAUSED active session is served as active only while the app keeps refreshing the snapshot (~10s heartbeat); once the snapshot is stale beyond the 15s grace (app closed/crashed) the sidecar reports it inactive so the widget clears it. A live paused timer stays shown.

features.action: KDE widget builds its task list (grouped, capped)
features.expected: Tasks grouped by project with headers; list length capped; empty state renders cleanly.

features.action: KDE widget 'Today' filter matches the app's Today
features.expected: Widget taskMatchesToday matches the Vue isTodayTask, incl. scheduled-today with stale calendar instances (BUG-1908).

features.action: KDE nudge popup appears with correct dimensions/logic
features.expected: Nudge popup sizing + trigger logic correct; bounded lifetime (watchdog closes it).

features.action: KDE pre-end warning fires before session end
features.expected: Warning fires at the configured seconds-before-end; honours the setting.

features.action: KDE full-screen break overlay covers the screen
features.expected: Overlay matches screen dimensions; bounded lifetime via the watchdog.

features.action: KDE nanny/quiet gates block notifications when configured
features.expected: nannyQuietToday and related gates correctly suppress notifications.

features.action: KDE widget signs in / maintains its own session
features.expected: Sign-in request shape correct; token handling for the widget's independent session.

features.action: KDE widget config toggles persist and reload
features.expected: Toggles persist via config/main.xml + plasmoid.configuration and survive a widget reload.
gaps: config persistence is verified live (kwriteconfig6/journal) per the memory SOP, not by an automated unit test

features.action: Sign in, persist session across restart
features.expected: Session + identity persist; Electron survives update+restart; auth-aware store init.

features.action: Refresh token + reconnect grace
features.expected: Multi-tab refresh + realtime rebind; offline grace; identity preserved on passive sign-out.

features.action: Create a project
features.expected: Project persists; appears in pickers; survives reload.

features.action: Rename a project / set icon
features.expected: Rename persists; emoji/SVG/gradient icon rendered.

features.action: Set project color
features.expected: Color persists and is reflected everywhere the project shows.

features.action: Set a project's Kanban view type (status/date/priority)
features.expected: View type persists per project.

features.action: Delete project(s) (single + bulk)
features.expected: Tasks re-home to Uncategorized, not lost; deletion persists; tombstoned.

features.action: Select active project (filter views to it)
features.expected: Active project filters visible tasks; persists across navigation.

features.action: Schedule a task reminder / notification
features.expected: Notification scheduled for the due date/time; delivered once; cleared when the task changes.

features.action: Schedule notifications for a recurring task
features.expected: Each occurrence notifies; no duplicate/miss across the series.

features.action: Snooze / dismiss a notification
features.expected: Snooze reschedules; dismiss clears without re-firing.

features.action: Set notification preferences (per task / default)
features.expected: Preferences persist and govern future scheduling.

features.action: Create a workspace
features.expected: Workspace created; user is owner; scoped data isolated.

features.action: Switch active workspace
features.expected: Outgoing data wiped, incoming loaded, no leak; durable writes resume.

features.action: Delete a workspace
features.expected: Guarded; owner-only; scoped data handled; no cross-scope leak.

features.action: Generate an invite link / accept an invite
features.expected: Invite links resolve; accept adds membership with correct role.
gaps: end-to-end invite acceptance needs a live multi-member harness (deferred team lane)

features.action: Change member role / remove member / leave
features.expected: Role change + removal + leave enforce RLS; no stale-auth writes.
gaps: revocation/owner-transfer under concurrent write is DEFERRED team vector #24

features.action: Guest data stays isolated from workspace data
features.expected: Guest and workspace scopes never bleed into each other.

features.action: Change any setting → persist locally + sync
features.expected: Debounced upsert; excludes secrets; local save does not mask a failed remote sync.

features.action: Toggle Done column / hide-done / done-task visibility
features.expected: Toggle persists; views re-filter reactively.

features.action: Toggle showing Google Calendar events
features.expected: External events appear/disappear; no owned-task side effects.

features.action: Toggle auto-start pomodoros / breaks
features.expected: Auto-start behaviour follows the setting.

features.action: Toggle day-group position rotation / suggestions
features.expected: Rotation on/off governs layout; no write storm when off.

features.action: Change language / RTL direction
features.expected: Language + direction apply app-wide and persist.

features.action: Toggle Electron auto-update
features.expected: Auto-update check honours the setting.
gaps: updater version/marker/handoff flow is covered; the autoUpdateEnabled toggle GATING the check is not isolated in a test; auto-update is a per-device local setting, intentionally not synced

features.action: Multi-select nodes (click, rubber-band rect)
features.expected: Selection tracks nodes; bulk actions operate on the exact selection incl. hidden.

features.action: Pan / zoom / save+restore viewport
features.expected: Viewport persists and restores; zoom-out performance bounded.

features.action: Add / move / delete / restore a canvas image
features.expected: Image persists at position; delete is undoable; restore returns it.

features.action: Canvas keyboard shortcuts (delete, group with G, select)
features.expected: Hotkeys act on selection; ignored while typing in inputs.

features.action: Send a message / stream a reply
features.expected: User + assistant messages persist; streaming completes; error surfaced.

features.action: Create / switch / rename / delete a conversation
features.expected: Conversation CRUD persists and syncs; delete does not orphan messages.

features.action: Undo the AI's last applied action
features.expected: Reverses the applied command batch via the rollback receipt.

features.action: Open / close / toggle the AI panel; set language/direction
features.expected: Panel state + language/direction persist.

features.action: Toggle main / secondary sidebar, focus mode
features.expected: Layout state persists; footer reflects auth state.

features.action: Open / close modals (edit, batch-edit, group, delete, shortcuts, settings, auth)
features.expected: Modals open/close cleanly; edit modal fails closed on save error; no leaked listeners on unmount.

features.action: Navigate between views (Board/Calendar/Canvas/Catalog/Focus/Quick Sort/AI)
features.expected: No critical JS errors across navigations; each view loads authenticated data.

features.action: Search tasks
features.expected: Search returns matching tasks; API search contract stable.

features.action: Brain-dump quick capture of many tasks
features.expected: Every captured line becomes a durable task; none dropped.

features.action: Morning dashboard / Big Three capture
features.expected: Big Three tasks created undo-aware and persist.

features.action: First-run onboarding flow
features.expected: Onboarding completes once and does not re-trigger; no data created unexpectedly.
